newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Gabetti losses grow in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Gabetti losses grow in H1 1996.

text.p: Italy's Gabetti group, one of the country's leading real estate companies, saw first half 1996 losses grow to 2.05 billion lire from 1.37 billion in the same 1995 period, mainly due to extraordinary restructuring charges of 3.08 billion lire.
Gross revenues rose slightly to 90.6 billion lire from 79.5 billion while net debt was little changed at 528.3 billion against 534.6 billion.

The half-yearly results were strongly affected by the restructuring charges linked mainly to management changes under a programme set to end in December and which "will show considerable benefits from 1997 onwards."

The second half would therefore still be impacted but some of the charges would be offset by extraordinary gains from property sales. The real estate market, the company added, still appeared fairly static.
